documents.title: 뇌과학 기반의 IT융합 신산업 육성에 관한 탐색적 연구
documents.abstract: 뇌과학 기반 lT융합 산업은 뇌과학을 IT기술과 융합하여 국민의 건강을 획기적으로 개선시킬 것으로 기대되는 뇌과학 기반의 IT서비스를 발굴하고, 이러한 서비스를 토대로 새로운 시장을 형성할 산업으로서 우리나라의 신성장동력 산업으로 발전할 것이 기대되고 있다. 이에 본 연구는 이러한 뇌과학 기반의 IT융합 신산업 육성에 관한 정책을 탐색적으로 제안하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 본 연구는 첫째, 뇌과학 기반 IT융합산업 생태계를 정의하고, 둘째, 뇌과학 기반 IT융합산업의 서비스 유형을 구분하며, 셋째, 본 산업의 활성화를 위한 정책 방향 및 추진 전략을 제안한다.
documents.author: 노규성;주성환;

documents.title: A Study on the Change of Clinical Self-Confidence according to the Number of Clinical Dental Hygiene Practices of Students in the Department of Dental Hygiene - Focusing on scaling practices -
documents.abstract: The purpose of this study was to provide the basic data needed to plan the effective teaching design of scaling education and to measure the changes in students' confidence in performing scaling according to the number of scaling practices. Scaling education is presented as a core basic hygiene competency of dental hygienists and evaluated as the practical competency of dental hygienists. This study selected 48 third-year students from the department of dental hygiene at S University in Asan, and analyzed data from completed participant surveys. The degree of 'confidence in facing the subject in clinical practice,' 'confidence in applying hand instrument to the subject,' and 'confidence in applying ultrasonic instruments to the subject' was assessed on a five-point Likert scale. The difference in confidence was analyzed during five practice sessions. Each response was compared using frequency analysis, chi-square test, and repeated measurement ANOVA. Students who complained of a lack of confidence in the 14.6%, 25.0%, and 12.5%, respectively, in face-to-face practice, hand instruments, and ultrasonic instrument application responses. The more the practice was repeated, the more confident students were in all three categories, and the more statistically significant (p<0.001). As the number of scaling practice sessions increased, students' confidence in performing scaling also improved. In particular, the level of self-confidence was higher after the third practice session when compared to the first session. Therefore, it is necessary to design effective courses for teaching scaling practices so that at least three repetitive practice periods can be provided in clinical dental hygiene practices.
documents.author: Choi, Yong-Keum;Kim, Mi-Sun;Jeong, Su-Ra;Kim, Eun-Jeong;

documents.title: 플립러닝 기반의 임상치위생학 교육과정 개발 및 적용 사례연구
documents.abstract: Objectives: The purpose of this study is to prove, through the design and operation of a teaching learning model for clinical dental hygiene and practice III, the effectiveness of the flipped learning PARTNER model. Methods: A professional council was formed, composed of three professors of dental hygiene and one professor of education; each member was an expert with a Ph.D. From December 2018 to February 2019. Results: Learning preferences for the clinical learning hygiene curriculum based on flip learning showed that it had higher accessibility than traditional teaching methods. Subjects' motivation to learn was improved through flip learning, their critical thinking ability was improved through active discussion and flip team discussion, and their self-directed learning ability was also improved. Participation increased through flipped learning, and subjects' skill abilities showed their highest score by improving their performance through the whole lecture. A high satisfaction of 4.54 out of 5 points was achieved. Conclusions: It was confirmed that the development and operation of a flipped learning-based clinical hygiene curriculum can provide an effective and satisfactory learning process.
documents.author: 정수라;김미선;김은정;최용금;

documents.title: New IT R&D 발전방안
documents.abstract: IT산업은 '97년 외환위기를 기점으로 고성장을 거듭하였고, 세계 10위권 규모의 경제 강국으로 성장하는데 있어 국내 산업의 대표적인 성장동력으로서 자리 매김하였다. 하지만, 최근 성장률이 예전만 못하다는 우려의 목소리와 함께 IT가 한 단계 더 업그레이드하기 위해서는 자신의 허물을 과감히 벗는 용기가 필요하다는 것이 일반적인 시각이다. 이러한 흐름속에서 기존 IT전략과 차별화된 New IT 발전방안을 수립하게 되었다. 지금까지의 IT전략이 IT 고도화 추진을 위한 IT 중심 발전 전략이었다면, New IT전략은 IT기반 융합산업, IT융합 신산업, Next IT산업 등3대 성장축간 시너지 창출이 가능한 IT로의 수렴과 확산이 핵심이라고 할 수 있다. IT기반 융합산업의 최종 목표는 전통산업과 IT가 만나 자동차, 조선, 의료, 국방, 건설, 섬유, 기계항공 등 7개 주력기간산업의 고부가가치화 및 초일류화를 우선 실현하는 것이다. IT융합 신산업의 최종 목표는 나노(NT), 바이오(BT), 인지기술(CT) 등 비(非)IT와 교감을 통하여 IT가 에너지, 환경, 건강 등 사회적 문제를 해결하고, 녹색성장 추진의 핵심인 5대 신산업을 창출하는데 있다. 5대 신산업으로는 Green IT산업, Welfare-Infra산업, 감성조명산업, 인지단말산업, THz응용산업 등을 꼽을 수 있다. Next IT산업은 기존 14대 IT 분야를 'ETRI 비전 2020' 등 미래 청사진을 바탕으로 장기적 관점에서 재설계한 것이며, 최종 목표는 TDX, 4M D램, CDMA, 와이브로, DMB, NoLA 등 IT 강국 계보를 이어갈 4G, 미래인터넷, Smart Radio, 실감미디어, 웹3.0, 투명전자소자 등 미래 유망 핵심원천기술을 확보하고, IT 경쟁력을 강화하는 것이다.
documents.author: 최문기

documents.title: IT 융합서비스 및 활용기술의 기술속성에 관한 연구 : 산업간 융합을 중심으로
documents.abstract: IT 융합산업은 높은 부가가치 창출이 기대되나 IT 융합서비스는 아직 도입기로써 과거에는 시도하지 않은 개발 방법론과 미래적 정보기술을 활용해야 하므로 서비스 도입과 기술 개발 시 개발성공의 위험성이 존재한다. IT 융합서비스와 활용기술들이 각각 제시되고는 있으나 특정 서비스의 성공적인 구현을 위해서 어떤 기술이 필요한지 명확히 파악하는 것이 어려운 실정이다. 그리고 IT 융합서비스는 서비스의 구현단계 이전에 기술이 포함하고 있는 속성과 서비스가 요구하는 속성을 고려하여 적절한 기술과 서비스의 발전방향을 모색해야 하는 분야임에도 이에 대한 고려 없이 서비스의 공급자 입장에서 IT 융합 기술이나 서비스를 개발하려는 경향이 있다. 이러한 관점에서 본 연구는 IT 융합산업의 서비스와 서비스를 구현하기 위한 활용기술의 사례를 도출하고 이를 구분된 기술속성분류체계를 이용하여 설문조사를 실시하였다. 그리고 조사된 결과를 바탕으로 IT 융합서비스에 활용되는 기술들의 기술속성에 대한 수준과 특징을 알아보고 그들의 상관관계와 상보성을 분석하였다. IT 융합서비스 측면에서는 서비스가 요구하는 기술속성의 수준과 특징을 파악하고 그 상관관계를 분석하였고 서비스를 산업별로 분류하여 산업별로 기술속성의 수준과 활용되는 기술들의 상보성을 분석하였다. 마지막으로 IT 융합서비스와 활용기술에 대한 부합도를 분석하였다. 본 연구는 IT 융합서비스 구현을 위한 기술의 수준과 앞으로 기술들의 발전방향을 예측하였으며 IT융합서비스의 기술적 요구를 충족시킬 수 있는 기술들을 제시하였다. 그리고 최적의 IT 융합서비스와 이의 구현을 위해 활용되는 기술들의 관계를 설명하였다. 본 연구의 결과는 최적의 IT 융합서비스 도입과 운영을 위한 기술선택과 평가지표로 활용 될 것으로 기대되며 향후 IT 융합서비스와 활용기술을 사전에 인지하고 예측하여 투자 효율성을 극대화하거나 서비스 사업자들의 적극적인 서비스 집중화 및 기술 개발 유도를 위해 이용할 수 있을 것이다.
documents.author: 김동관

documents.title: IT융합 스마트조명 기술
documents.abstract: IT융합 스마트조명 기술은 LED 조명기술과 IT기술이 융합된 복합적인 조명시스템의 개발 기술이다. 본고에서는 IT융합 스마트조명의 개념과 목적, 구성에 대하여 기술하고 이를 활용한 일반조명에서의 적용분야에 대하여 알아본다.
documents.author: 김훈;이민욱;

documents.title: 조선.해양플랜트에서의 IT융합 적용
documents.abstract: 조선해양플랜트산업은 우리나라 경제발전의 주도적 역할을 해온 효자산업이다. 이 글에서는 이와 같은 조선해양플랜트 IT융합산업의 특징을 설명함은 물론, 개발현황과 개발사례를 소개하여 그 발전방향을 제시하고자 한다.
documents.author: 한경수;한상철;박정호;

documents.title: IT융합 헬스케어기술
documents.abstract: 본고에서는 IT 기술의 급속한 발전과 보급에 힘입어 최근 많은 관심을 끌고 있는 미래의 의료형태인 유헬스케어에 필요한 IT융합 헬스케어기술을 소개하였다. IT융합 헬스케어기술이 성공적으로 실시되면 맞춤형 헬스케어 서비스와 웰빙을 필요로 하는 많은 이용자의 요구에 의해서 헬스케어는 환자 중심의 질병 및 증상을 완화하고, 치료하는 개념에서 점차 일반인의 건강을 증진하고 질병을 예방하는 개념으로 변화 되고 있다. 이를 위해서는 IT 기술과 의료서비스를 융합하여 언제 어디서나 예방, 진료, 치료 그리고 사후관리를 받을 수 있는 유헬스케어 서비스가 제공될 수 있을 것이다.
documents.author: 박정훈;황보택근;

documents.title: IT융합 산업의 도약전략
documents.abstract: 융합의 현상은 기술간, 디바이스간, 산업간 등으로 확장되고 있으며 그 유형도 매우 복잡하고 다양하다. IT융합도 기술의 발전과 함께 다양한 산업 곳곳으로 확산되며 정보화 사회를 넘어 모든 산업에 IT가 융합되는 지능기반(Smart) 사회로 IT산업의 패러다임이 변화하고 있다. 또한 IT융합 시장 규모도 점차 성장할 전망이다. 세계 IT융합 시장 규모가 2010년 1.2조 달러에서 2020년 3.6조 달러로 연평균 11.8%의 고성장이 전망되고 국내 IT융합시장 규모도 2020년에 1,237억 달러로 세계시장 성장률보다 높은 13%대의 성장을 예측했다. 이미 미국, EU, 일본 등 선진국들도 IT를 중심으로 산업간 융합전략을 추진하고 있다. IT융합은 자동차, 조선, 건설, 의료, 섬유 등 다양한 전통산업과 IT가 접목되어 새로운 혁신의 장을 만들고 있다. 우리 정부도 'IT융합 확산전략'을 발표하고 새로운 도전을 시작했다. 선진 일류국가 도약을 위해 IT산업 경쟁력을 기반으로 주력산업과의 융합을 촉진하여 신 시장을 개척해 나가야 한다. 정보통신산업 진흥원도 IT융합시대를 이끌 견인차가 되기 위해 2011년에 IT융합정책의 전략목표로 (1) IT융합 인식 확산 및 제도 개선 (2) 다양한 IT기술과 산업협력 모델 발굴 (3) 신 시장 창출을 통한 IT융합 확산 (4) 창의적 IT융합인재 양성을 선정했다. IT융합 전략의 성공적인 추진과 미래 산업사회의 요구를 충족시키기 위해 산업계의 목소리에 귀 기울이고 정부와 산업계를 잇는 가교 역할을 충실히 할 것이다.
documents.author: 정경원

documents.title: 철도 IT융합 기술 연구개발 기획 연구
documents.abstract: 철도는 친환경 교통 물류수단으로 각광받고 있으며, 세계 철도차량시장 점유율 확대를 위해 IT 기술을 융합하여 경쟁력을 강화하고자 하는 노력이 진행되고 있다. 본 연구는 철도 IT융합 기술의 연구개발을 진행하기 위한 방안을 제시한다. 철도 IT융합 기술과 관련한 기존 연구결과물 및 특허에 대해 분석하고 기술분류에 따른 대상과제를 도출한 후, 전문가 설문조사와 다원속성효용이론(MAUT) 방법론을 이용하여 핵심 연구과제를 선정하였다. 연구 결과는 철도 IT융합에 대한 향후 정책 수립 및 연구과제 기획 등에 활용할 수 있을 것이다.
documents.author: 장태우;이홍주;이준호;원종운;이석;

documents.title: IT융합 현황 및 정책과제
documents.abstract: 산업 패러다임이 융합의 시대로 진화되며 IT기반의 IT융합 중요성이 강조되고 있다. IT융합 시장은 국내외적으로 급성장 추세이며 이에 따라 정보통신진흥원은 IT융합에 대한 인식 확산 및 제도 개선, 다양한 IT기술과 산업협력 모델 발굴, 신시장 창출을 통한 IT융합 확산 및 창의적 IT융합인재 양성 등을 주요 정책과제로 시행함으로써 IT산업과 주력산업간 융합을 효과적으로 추진하고 확산할 계획이다.
documents.author: 신재식

documents.title: 세무회계 관련 학과의 특성화 추진 방향과 전략에 관한 탐색적 연구－K대학을 중심으로－
documents.abstract: Due to the change in paradigm pursuing the era of knowledge based creative economy, it is expected for the vocational schools in college level to educate & train specialists who are able to contribute to the development of regional & national economy rather than general study and research. The objective of this research is to raise competitiveness through searching for right strategy and studying on how to make department of tax accounting and related departments more distinct.The mission of K College was to educate the best specialists in the field of tax accounting in Korea. Hence, the college set the aim as training core specialists for convergence tax accounting, who are suited for knowledge based creative economy. Therefore, core strategies for distinction on the basis of sustainable growth can be presented such as vocational training based on NCS, enhancement of studying capability, raising job competitiveness, personality education and internationalization.To accomplish distinction, a number of factors were considered for providing detailed strategies. Those were cooperation with regional industries and analysis of labor demands, sustainable Improvement of education quality (CQI), training multitasking workforce with reflection of the change in industrial coaching, fulfillment of the role of the department for creative economy through fostering specialists with sound personality.Detailed strategies were as follows. For vocational education on the basis of NCS, 1) development & management of the curriculum based on NCS, 2) improvement on vocational capability, 3) enhancement of hands－on job capability for professors and students. For enhancement of studying capability, 1) enhancement of basic study capability, 2) creative education focusing on real job ability, 3) Self oriented study capability. For raising job competitiveness, 1) establishment of industry academy cooperation networks, 2) tailored coaching of job search, 3) re－education of graduates. For personality education and internationalization, 1) providing management consulting services for small & mid sized enterprises (going abroad), 2) fostering global core workforce, 3) education of social service & job ethics.Further cooperative research on how to develop department of tax accounting & related departments in a strategic manner shall be needed to respond to the rapidly changing circumstances more efficiently.
documents.author: 윤우영;이태정;최수천;김영락;

documents.title: Maize Leaf Disease Identification Based on Feature Enhancement and DMS-Robust Alexnet
documents.abstract: The identification of maize leaf diseases will meet great challenges because of the difficulties in extracting lesion features from the constant-changing environment, uneven illumination reflection of the incident light source and many other factors. In this paper, a novel maize leaf disease recognition method is proposed. In this method, we first designed a maize leaf feature enhancement framework with the capability of enhancing the features of maize under the complex environment. Then a novel neural network is designed based on backbone Alexnet architecture, named DMS-Robust Alexnet. In the DMS-Robust Alexnet, dilated convolution and multi-scale convolution are combined to improve the capability of feature extraction. Batch normalization is performed to prevent network over-fitting while enhancing the robustness of the model. PRelu activation function and Adabound optimizer are employed to improve both convergence and accuracy. In experiments, it is validated from different perspectives that the maize leaf disease feature enhancement algorithm is conducive to improving the capability of the DMS-Robust Alexnet identification. Our method demonstrates strong robustness for maize disease images collected in the natural environment, providing a reference for the intelligent diagnosis of other plant leaf diseases.
documents.author: Lv, Mingjie;Zhou, Guoxiong;He, Mingfang;Chen, Aibin;Zhang, Wenzhuo;Hu, Yahui;

documents.title: Particle Swarm Optimization for Sizing of Solar-Wind Hybrid Microgrids
documents.abstract: This study investigates the optimization of the size of a solar wind hybrid microgrid using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to improve energy production efficiency, economic feasibility, and overall sustainability. By using past solar and wind resource data, load demand profiles, and system component specifications, the PSO algorithm effectively maximized the capabilities of solar panels and wind turbines. The findings indicate a significant rise in daily energy production, with a 15% enhancement in solar panel capability and a 12% boost in wind turbine capability. The increased energy production plays a crucial role in dealing with the natural irregularity of renewable resources, hence enhancing the resilience and self-reliance of the microgrid. The economic calculations demonstrate significant improvements in the economic feasibility of the microgrid designs. The Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) undergoes a significant 10% decrease, suggesting a more economically efficient energy generation. Moreover, the payback time for the original expenditure is reduced by 15%, indicating faster returns on investment. The economic improvements highlight the practical advantages of using PSO for microgrid size, in line with the goal of creating sustainable energy solutions while minimizing economic costs. The improved performance of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is shown by a thorough comparison study with other optimization approaches, such as Genetic Algorithms (GA) and Simulated Annealing (SA). The superior convergence rate of PSO, together with a 15% enhancement in solution quality relative to GA and SA, underscores the efficiency and efficacy of PSO in traversing the complex solution space associated with microgrid size. PSO's comparative advantage makes it an effective tool for tackling the intricacies of integrating renewable energy, highlighting its potential for extensive use in microgrid design and optimization. The sensitivity evaluations demonstrate that the solutions optimized by the PSO are resilient even when important parameters vary, thereby highlighting the stability and dependability of the approach. In addition to technical and economic factors, the study evaluates the environmental consequences and social aspects of the optimum microgrid designs. The land use efficiency has seen a 10% enhancement, demonstrating the optimum application of area for renewable energy infrastructure. In addition, there is a 7% improvement in community approval, which demonstrates the algorithm's ability to effectively handle social aspects and promote a comprehensive and socially acceptable approach to renewable energy projects.
documents.author: Sanduru, Bhanuteja;Negi, Anup Singh;Sharma, Nittin;Bhalla, Lalit;Kalele, Girish;Vyas, Anjali;

documents.title: 연구개발투자가 경영성과와 고용에 미치는 영향 : 나노융합산업을 중심으로
documents.abstract: 나노기술은 IT(Information Technology), BT(Bio Technology), ET (Environment Technology) 등 新성장동력과의 상승적 융합을 통한 국가 경쟁력 향상에 획기적인 기여를 할 것으로 예상되고 있으며, 산업구조 고도화에도 파급효과가 클 것으로 판단되고 있다. 하지만, 현재 나노기술이 다양한 산업분야와의 융합이 활발해지고 있고, 나노융합산업으로 성장하는 과도기임에도 불구하고, 나노제품을 제조하는 나노기업의 전체 기술혁신 역량을 중심으로만 연구가 실시되었을 뿐, 이후 추가 연구는 미흡한 실정이다.&#xD; 본 연구에서는 국내 중소 나노기업의 기술혁신 역량에 따른 기업의 경영성과와 고용의 관계를 실증분석 하였으며, 나노융합산업의 특성을 반영한 3가지 요인(외부협력, 나노제품 유형, 마케팅 영역/범위)이 기업의 성과에 영향 요인으로 작용여부를 판단하고, 나노기업의 사업화 유형별 특성을 분석하였다. 이를 위해 전체 기술혁신의 관점이 아닌 나노의 관점에서 나노 R&amp;D투자를 중심으로 실증 분석하였다. &#xD; 실증분석을 위해 특정 시점의 기업 상황이 아닌 단위시간의 변화에 따른 기업의 성과를 검증하기 위해 2013년부터 2017년까지 「나노융합산업조사」를 통해 조사된 2012년부터 2016년까지의 5년간의 나노기업 DB를 활용하였다. 또한, 제시한 가설의 검증을 위해 기존 선행연구에서 주로 사용된 회귀분석이 아닌 기업별 특성과 연도별 추세를 동시에 고려할 수 있는 패널(Panel) 분석법을 활용하였다. &#xD; 나노기업의 사업화에 영향을 미치는 세 가지 요소를 제시하여 각각의 조절효과를 확인하기 위한 ‘위계적 방법에 의한 조절 회귀분석’을 동시에 실시하여 동 연구에서 제시한 연구모형 및 가설을 검증하였다.&#xD; 그 결과는 다음과 같다. 첫째, 나노기업이 나노제품 개발을 위한 나노 R&amp;D투자는 기업의 전체 경영성과와 고용에 유의미한 관련성은 없으나, 나노 관련 경영성과 및 고용에는 긍정적(+)인 효과가 있는 것으로 확인되었다.&#xD; 둘째, ①개방형 혁신 추진 여/부는 기업의 나노 관련 경영성과에는 유의미한 관련성을 보이지 않았으나, 나노 관련 고용에는 긍정적(+)인 효과를 보이는 것으로 분석되었다. ②나노 최종재의 생산 여/부는 나노 관련 경영성과 및 고용에 유의미한 관련성이 없었다. ③나노제품의 수출 여/부는 나노 관련 경영성과 및 고용 모두에 긍정적(+)인 효과가 있음을 확인 하였다.&#xD; 셋째, 앞서 분석한 3가지 영향요인(외부협력, 나노제품 유형, 마케팅 영역/범위)을 토대로 기업의 8가지 유형으로 분류 특성을 분석하였다. 이를 통해 &lt;유형 4&gt;인 나노기업의 나노 R&amp;D투자는 기업의 경영성과와 고용 모두에서 긍정적(+)인 영향이 있는 것을 확인할 수 있었다. &lt;유형 8&gt;인 나노기업의 나노 R&amp;D투자는 기업의 경영성과에만 긍정적(+)인 영향을 미치는 것으로 확인되었다. &lt;유형 2&gt;인 나노기업과 &lt;유형 3&gt;인 나노기업은 고용에만 긍정적(+)인 영향을 미치는 것으로 확인할 수 있었다.&#xD; 이러한 결과를 통해 정부 정책적 지원 측면에서 나노기업의 개방형 혁신은 기업의 고용에 밀접한 관련성이 있는 것이 확인되었다. 즉, 나노 R&amp;D투자가 나노 관련 고용으로 연결되기 위해서는 나노기업의 폐쇄형 기술개발 보다는 개방형 기술개발을 통해 타 기관(산/학/연)과의 교류를 늘리고, 외부 기술의 도입 및 전문기관 활용, 전문가 자문 등의 활동을 활발히 수행할 수 있는 정책적 지원이 필요한 것으로 보인다. 또한, 사업화 측면에서 나노기업의 경영자는 나노 원소재, 중간재, 최종재에 따라 전략적으로 마케팅 방법 및 영역 등 시장공략법을 차별화 하는 방안이 필요하다. &#xD; 마지막으로 국내 나노융합산업에 대한 선행연구가 많이 부족한 실정이고, 2012년 「나노융합산업조사」가 처음 실시된 이후로 최근에서야 산업 분석을 위한 기업 DB가 마련되었다. 본 연구는 이를 이용한 첫 실증분석 연구로 나노기업의 나노 관련 연구개발 투자에 따른 성과에 관해 실증적인 분석이 시도 되었다는 점에서 의미가 있으나, 앞으로 더 많은 다양한 연구들이 필요한 상황이다.
documents.author: 김경환

documents.title: DCP-YOLOv7x: improved pest detection method for low-quality cotton image
documents.abstract:
Introduction

Pests are important factors affecting the growth of cotton, and it is a challenge to accurately detect cotton pests under complex natural conditions, such as low-light environments. This paper proposes a low-light environments cotton pest detection method, DCP-YOLOv7x, based on YOLOv7x, to address the issues of degraded image quality, difficult feature extraction, and low detection precision of cotton pests in low-light environments.

Methods

The DCP-YOLOv7x method first enhances low-quality cotton pest images using FFDNet (Fast and Flexible Denoising Convolutional Neural Network) and the EnlightenGAN low-light image enhancement network. This aims to generate high-quality pest images, reduce redundant noise, and improve target features and texture details in low-light environments. Next, the DAttention (Deformable Attention) mechanism is introduced into the SPPCSPC module of the YOLOv7x network to dynamically adjust the computation area of attention and enhance the feature extraction capability. Meanwhile, the loss function is modified, and NWD (Normalized Wasserstein Distance) is introduced to significantly improve the detection precision and convergence speed of small targets. In addition, the model detection head part is replaced with a DyHead (Dynamic Head) structure, which dynamically fuses the features at different scales by introducing dynamic convolution and multi-head attention mechanism to enhance the model's ability to cope with the problem of target morphology and location variability.

Results

The model was fine-tuned and tested on the Exdark and Dk-CottonInsect datasets. Experimental results show that the detection Precision (P) of DCP-YOLOv7x for cotton pests is 95.9%, and the Mean Average Precision (mAP@0.5) is 95.4% under a low-light environments, showing improvements of 14.4% and 15.6%, respectively, compared to YOLOv7x. Experiments on the Exdark datasets also achieved better detection results, verifying the effectiveness of the DCP-YOLOv7x model in different low-light environments.

Discussion

Fast and accurate detection of cotton pests using DCP-YOLOv7x provides strong theoretical support for improving cotton quality and yield. Additionally, this method can be further integrated into agricultural edge computing devices to enhance its practical application value.

documents.title: 디자이너의 역량강화를 위한 확장현실(XR)기반 에듀테크 콘텐츠 모델 연구 : A Study on XR(eXtended Reality)-based EdTech Contents Model for the Designer’s Capacity Building
documents.abstract: 4차 산업혁명의 주요 분야로 언급되는 인공지능(AI), 정보통신기술(ICT), 사물인터넷(IoT), 빅데이터 등의 기술혁신이 일어나면서 신기술과 결합한 새로운 분야에 대한 사용자들의 관심이 늘어나고 있다. 이로인해 디자인 분야도 심미성을 기반으로 한 조형 활동뿐만 아니라 서비스나 비즈니스 모델 등 무형적 가치를 만드는 콘텐츠 위주로 확장되어가고 있다.&#xD; 하지만 매년 다양한 분야에 디자인 인력 고용이 필요함에도 불구하고, 실제 채용계획은 비슷한 상태에 머물러 있어서 기업과 디자이너 간의 원하는 경력과 역량을 일치시키기에 어려움이 있다. 또한, 대부분 분야별 전문직 은퇴 시기가 평균 경제활동 수명보다 짧아지고 있어서, 넓은 세대를 포함할 수 있도록 분야 간 융합을 기반으로 한 새로운 학습법과 교육 콘텐츠가 주목받고 있다.&#xD; 본 연구자는 변화하는 디자인 패러다임에 대응하기 위해 시간적, 물리적 부담감을 해소할 수 있는 디자이너의 역량 강화 연구가 필요하며, 이를 위해 전문가 재교육을 위한 새로운 학습 모델이 있어야 한다고 판단하였다. 그에 대한 대안으로 특정 기능만을 활용하는 것이 아닌 교육 단계별 콘텐츠에 알맞은 기술 지원이 가능하도록 하는 확장현실 기반의 에듀테크 콘텐츠 모델을 연구하였다.&#xD; 에듀테크는 전 세계적으로 성장하고 있는 교육시장으로 인공지능을 바탕으로 한 확장현실, 블록체인, 빅데이터 등과 같은 신기술과 융합되어 미국, 중국, 인도, 일본, 영국의 교육환경에 적극적으로 적용되고 있다. 무엇보다 확장현실을 활용한 에듀테크 콘텐츠는 지역 간, 세대 간, 소득격차 간 일어날 수 있는 교육격차를 해소하고, 양질의 교육을 할 수 있다는 점에서 국가적 차원으로도 활용되고 있다. 주로 에듀테크 콘텐츠로 활용되는 온라인 학습은 PC와 모바일로 이루어지며, 디지털 보드, 화상수업 등을 활용하지만 개별적 학습은 일방적인 영상으로 진행되는 편이다. 하지만, 시대에 앞선 학습과 고민이 선행되어야 할 디자이너를 위한 교육은 사용자와의 상호작용이 중요해지면서 새로운 미디어를 적극적으로 활용하고자 하는 노력이 요구된다. 특히, 확장현실 기반 에듀테크 콘텐츠가 부족하여 시간과 장소에 구애받지 않으며 디자이너 역량 단계별 차등을 두고 학습할 수 있는 확장현실 기반의 에듀테크 콘텐츠 모델이 필요하다.&#xD; 이를 위해 에듀테크와 확장현실(XR;eXtended Reality)의 개념 및 특징을 살펴 본 후 전문가 심층 인터뷰를 통하여 디자이너 역량 3단계(Entry Level, Intermediate Level, Expert Level)와 확장현실 기반 에듀테크 콘텐츠 요소(디바이스, 콘텐츠, 서비스)를 도출하였다. 각 요소의 당위성과 디자이너 역량 및 확장현실 기반 에듀테크 콘텐츠 요소 간 유의성 점검을 위해 정량적 분석을 하고, 확장현실 체험자 대상 인터뷰를 통해 기존의 디자인 교육과의 차별점과 적용가능성을 확인하는 정성적 분석도 동시 진행하였다. 디자이너는 역량단계에 따라 학습목적과 기대효과가 다르며, 확장현실 기반 에듀테크 콘텐츠 개발 시 주요하게 적용되어야 하는 요소가 있어서 이를 바탕으로 디자이너 역량강화를 위한 확장현실 기반 에듀테크 콘텐츠 모델을 제시하였다.&#xD; 결론으로 제시한 확장현실 기반의 에듀테크 컨텐츠 모델은 디자이너가 강화하고 싶은 역량이 무엇인지 단계별 선택이 가능하며, 디자이너 역량 단계별 요소는 확장현실 기반 에듀테크 활용 시 특정 요소가 영향을 더 받는 양상을 보여서 디바이스, 콘텐츠, 서비스 영역으로 구분하였다. 제시한 모델을 통해서 디자이너의 역량 단계에 따른 학습이 가능하고, 각 단계마다 요구하는 역할과 역량에 맞는 확장현실 기반 에듀테크 콘텐츠를 선정할 수 있다. 그 중 디자이너의 역량강화를 위해 디자인 학습 단계별로 적용하고, 증강콘텐츠를 활용한 활동이 학습흥미와 몰입도를 높혀 시뮬레이션을 통한 반복 학습으로 관련 내용을 오래 기억할 수 있다.&#xD; 본 연구의 결과물로 제시한 확장현실 기반 에듀테크 콘텐츠 모델을 통해 확장현실을 활용한 교육내용을 실감있게 표현하는 방식은 지속적으로 진화할 것이다. 이에 디자이너의 역량강화를 목적으로 실제 전문가 콘텐츠 개발이 이루어진다면 보다 효율적인 디자인 학습환경을 만들 수 있으리라 기대한다.

documents.title: 산업단지캠퍼스 사업에 대한 평가 : 창원대학교 메카융합 산업단지캠퍼스를 사례로
documents.abstract: An Industrial Complex is a combination of the university and the industrial cluster. This study aims to analyze the effect of the Mechatronics Convergence Industrial Complex Campus on Changwon Cluster. This study was conducted based on the survey of the firms which are participants in the Mechatronics Convergence Industrial Complex Campus Project. The main findings are as follows.&#xD; 1) There are two problems in the Industrial Complex Campus. One is that the Industrial Complex Campus shows an uneven distribution in South Korea. More than half of the Industrial Complex Campuses are located in metropolitan cities. The other is the inefficiency of cultivating programs of human resources. The program, the cultivating of human resources, has similar programs with other policy agendas.&#xD; 2) The Mechatronics Convergence Industrial Complex Campus, in the Changwon National University, aims to reinforce capabilities of the firm and to cultivate human resources for workers at the company and students at the university. Therefore, the Mechatronics Convergence Industrial Complex Campus operates programs of the supporting of enterprises, the cultivating of human resources, and the cooperation of research development.&#xD; 3) Many of the Companies, which are participants in the project, are small and medium-sized businesses with more than ten years of establishment, and they need to develop new technologies. Also, they abandoned the technological development due to the insufficiency of funds, difficulty in securing research and production workforce, although they recognize the necessity of the technological development.&#xD; 4) Many of companies, which are participants in the project, are satisfied with the program of the supporting of enterprises, on the other hand, they are unsatisfied with the program of the cultivating of human resources and the cooperation of research development. Also, They have evaluated that the primary factors of difficulties in participating in the programs are the lack of funds and investigations reproductions.&#xD; 5) The evaluation of the Mechatronics Convergence Industrial Complex Campus, in the Changwon National University, shows that the project helps to secure the R&amp;D capability, the supporting the government policy, and the enhancement of the networking among the companies in Changwon Industrial Cluster. However, the project has a little impact on innovation in enterprises and Changwon Cluster in term of cultivation of the human resource, the higher value-added business, and the strengthening of informal networks.&#xD; The main policy recommendations which are based on the above analysis for the promoting of Industrial Complex Campus are as follows.&#xD; 1) It is necessary to change the programs of cultivating the human resources in the Industrial Complex Campus. The programs may be a waste of budget due to the redundant program with other policy agendas.&#xD; 2) The period of the project should be changed from three years to longer years. By promoting the Industrial Complex Campus Policy as a long-term, it will be possible to improve the productivity and profitability of the industrial cluster.&#xD; 3) It is necessary to establish a supporting financial system for the innovation of companies in Changwon Cluster. Most of the companies have abandoned experiencing in technology development due to the lack of funds. Also, the bank loan system and the government support system to solve the stringency of capital as companies are weak in the Changwon Cluster.

documents.title: Development of reproducible analytical platform for highly sensitive SERS-based assay
documents.abstract: Spectroscopy, which observes and interprets phenomena between light and matter, has been used in many diagnostic and sensing applications nowadays. Among them, Raman scattering is useful to biochemical and biomedical analysis. Raman scattering itself, however, has a very small optical cross-section which is problematic for the reproducibility of signal acquisition. This problem can be solved through surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) which uses the properties of the metal surface. Raman scattering improved by SERS has larger optical cross-section than fluorescence. SERS is a phenomenon in which the scattering of a material located on the surface is amplified through the inherent optical properties of the metal surface. The mechanism of this phenomenon is explained by electromagnetic field enhancement and chemical enhancement. In particular, there is a singularity in which SERS is greatly enhanced, which is called a hot spot. This singularity appears between the junctions, gaps, and crevices of metal nanoparticles or substrates. The quantitative value correlated with the enhancement of SERS is expressed by calculating and comparing enhancement factor (EF). Since the majority of EFs in SERS is heavily influenced by hotspots, sensitivity is determined by how hotspots are formed. Metal nanoparticles are used to obtain the SERS. Metal nanoparticles form localized surface plasmons (LSP) on the surface, a feature associated with SERS. Hot spots can be easily derived at junctions or gaps caused by clustering of nanoparticles. However, uncontrollable aggregation of nanoparticles is the anxiety factor for analysis and sensing such as quantitative detection. Hot spots caused by the aggregation of particles allow for highly sensitive detection, but unintentionally this leads to a detection error. For example, unintended strong SERS responses affect the correlation to the analyte concentration and the result is a loss of reliability of detection. In other words, this problem causes an issue in the reproducibility of SERS-based sensing.&#xD; Unintentional aggregation of particles has a tendency from the macro perspective. In order to reflect this tendency in the detection result, a method of obtaining an averaged pattern from the SERS response of the entire analysis solution is required. This measurement can be achieved by improving the ensemble-averaged effect. Microfluidic devices can implement micro or nanometer-sized fluids. Using this device, it is possible to induce a uniform reaction continuously in the flowing state and to improve the ensemble-averaged effect. It is also called Lab-on-a-Chip (LOC) or micro total analysis system (μTAS) because it enables laboratory-scale experiments and comprehensive analysis on the chip itself. Microfluidic devices types are divided into a single-phase microfluidic and a microdroplet using two different phase fluids according to fluid phase combination. The problem with this technique is that highly sensitive detection techniques are required to measure small scale reactions in the channel. Therefore, SERS is the most suitable technique to overcome this problem.&#xD; SERS-based imaging analysis, is difficult to exploit the ensemble-averaged effect, which is a feature of the platform presented above. Measuring the nanoparticles in their essentially fixed state determines the reproducibility of the assay based on the state of the nanoparticles themselves. In this case, both strong SERS response and stability of individual single particles must be considered. Cellular imaging is the most widely used field in SERS-based imaging analysis. The solvent environment in which the diversification of biological elements in cellular imaging occurs has a great impact on nanoparticle stability. For example, changes in salt concentrations, pHs and temperatures can cause serious problems in particle stability and consistency of SERS response. Therefore, SERS nanotags for biological applications require stability against external factors. In addition, there is a need for nanotags with a uniform SERS response.&#xD; Chapter 2 introduced a microfluidic device for detecting two different DNA markers mixed at different concentrations through nanoparticle-based SERS detection. The continuous flow of the channel was measured under conditions in which the SERS signal was generated by uncontrolled hot spots from the aggregation of silver nanoparticles. At this time, since the ensemble-averaged effect was maximized, the reproducible analysis could be performed. Based on this feature, highly sensitive detection of two different DNA markers could be performed using silver nanoparticles. This is a successful result showing the excellent synergy between nanoparticle-based highly sensitive detection and programmed microfluidic channels.&#xD; Chapter 3 introduced microdroplet devices which minimized the repetitive process required by conventional immunoassays. The immunoassay has performed on the channel using nanoparticles and magnetic beads to which the corresponding antibodies were conjugated, respectively. The immunocomplexes were separated through the magnetic field inside the channel without any washing steps. This programmed device implemented assay method does not require a washing process by separating the droplets containing immunocomplexes and the droplets of supernatant. This SERS-based droplet device for immunoassay has no memory effect and automatically performs a complex immunoassay on one device. This platform is expected to be a potential new immunoassay method.&#xD; Chapter 4 introduced novel nanotags which can be used stably in various biological environments with strong SERS responses. Unlike conventional spherical gold nanoparticles, this new nanotags were synthesized using hollow gold nanoparticles with unique optical properties due to the pinhole structure generated during particle synthesis. The hollow nanoparticles have a consistent SERS response capability in a single particle state by pinholes. The silver shell was formed on the surface of the hollow nanoparticles to form nanogaps between the shell and core, and to obtain an improved of SERS response. This, unlike gold nanoparticles, shows strong improvement along with unique properties of the hollow nanoparticles which were obtained by pinholes. However, as the surface was changed to silver, problems of stability loss and cytotoxicity appeared. To solve this problem, the surface was treated with poly(ethene glycol) (PEG) and successfully improved stability and biocompatibility. This stable nanotag was used for imaging analysis to distinguish the phenotypes of two different breast cancer cells.&#xD; The platform techniques introduced in this thesis could improve the reproducibility of nanoparticle-based SERS detection. The convergence platform of these techniques has the greatest potential for SERS-based sensing systems. In addition, it is expected to provide a new platform as a highly sensitive detection technique in the field of point-of-care testing (POCT), such as on-site diagnostics.

documents.title: IT 거버넌스 성숙도 향상을 위한 벤더 역할 분석
documents.abstract: 최근 많은 기업들에 있어 IT 거버넌스에 대한 중요성이 강조되고 있으며 이와 관련하여 다양한 관점에서의 연구가 진행되고 있다. 하지만, IT 아웃소싱이 일반화된 현재의 시장상황에서 기존 IT 거버넌스 연구는 클라이언트 관점에서 이들의 역할을 다룬 것이 대부분이었다. 또한 학계와 산업계 별로 IT 거버넌스에 대해 다양한 정의를 내리고 있고 조직구조 및 이해관계자들의 역할에서 IT 운영에 이르기까지 연구의 관점도 광범위한 실정이다. 본 논문에서는 기존 클라이언트 중심의 연구 한계에서 벗어나 기업의 IT 거버넌스 성숙도를 향상하기 위해 벤더가 가지고 있는 자원과 역량을 바탕으로 이들의 역할에 대한 개념적인 모델을 제시하였다. 이는 벤더 관점의 IT 거버넌스 연구에 있어 새로운 시사점을 제시하였다는데 의미를 가진다.

documents.title: 公共政策信賴性의 影響要因에 관한 硏究 : 兵役政策을 中心으로
documents.abstract: 본 논문에서는 병역정책신뢰에 대한 이론적 배경과 병역정책의 개념, 문제상황을 살펴본 후 병역정책신뢰에 영향을 미치는 요인을 체계적으로 규명하여 인과모형을 작성하고 이를 토대로 경험적 분석을 시도함으로써 향후 병역정책수립시 신뢰도제고 방향을 모색하는데 목적을 두었다. 본 논문에서는 먼저 신뢰에 대한 개념 정의와 함께 신뢰를 구성하고 있는 개념적 구성요소에 대해 정리하면서 신뢰의 유사개념인 협력(cooperation), 믿음(confidence), 예측 가능성(predicatabitity) 등과의 구별을 논의하였다. 또한 신뢰의 연구관점을 개인적 기대로서의 신뢰, 대인관계로서의 신뢰, 경제적 거래 관점에서의 신뢰, 사회적 실체로서의 신뢰로 구분하여 살펴봄과 동시에 신뢰에 대한 연구경향을 Mayer등이 제시한 신뢰의 일반모형과 다양한 유형의 신뢰와 발전에 초점을 둔 Zuker의 연구, Lewicki ＆ Bunker의 연구, Luhman의 연구를 구분하여 정리하였다. 이러한 신뢰에 대한 일반적 이론에 대한 논의와 사회심리학에서 논의된 태도이론을 토대로 하여 정책신뢰성에 대한 개념을 정의하면서 정책신뢰성과 관련된 선행연구를 검토하였다. 선행연구는 정치신뢰에 영향을 미치는 요인들을 인과관계란 측면에서 모델화 작업을 시도한 Co1e의 모형을 살펴본 후 경험적 연구에 있어서의 정책신뢰성의 영향요인을 검토하였다. 병역정책에 대한 이론 부분은 지금까지 병역정책전반에 대한 학문적 연구가 미비된 점을 고려하여 연구자의 병무행정 경험과 병무청, 국방연구원 등에서 발간된 자료를 바탕으로 병역의무에 대한 개념정의를 포함 병역정책의 성격규명, 선병정책과 의무부과정책에 대한 논의, 병역정책의 문제상황에 대해 논의하였다. 신뢰에 대한 일반이론과 선행연구의 검토, 병역정책에 대한 문제상황 등을 토대로 하여 병역정책신뢰성의 영향요인을 제시하고 인과모형과 가설을 설정한 후 경험적 연구를 하였으며 그 결과를 요약하면 다음과 같다. 첫째, ANOVA분석결과 인구학적 배경요인중 성별에 있어서는 1%유의수준에서 병역정책신뢰 수준에 차이를 보이고 있지 않으나 5%유의수준에서는 병역정책신뢰도에 있어서 차이를 보이고, 여자가 남자보다 병역정책신뢰도가 다소 높게 나타났다. 연령에 있어서는 30대 이하와 40대 이상에서 뚜렷한 차이를 보이고 있으며 40대 이상에서 병역정책신뢰도가 상대적으로 높게 나타나고 있다. 사회경제적 요인중 소득의 경우, 소득의 차이에 따른 병역정책신뢰수준의 차이를 보이고 있지 않으나 교육수준에 있어서는 대학이상의 학력소지자에 비해서 고등학교 졸업이하의 학력 소지자(무학 제외)가 병역정책신뢰도가 높게 나타나고 있다. 또한 직업에 있어서는 가정주부, 농·어업 종사자, 자영업자가 학생, 노동, 기능직 종사자, 일반 사무직, 전문직에 비해 병역정책신뢰도가 높게 나타나고 있고 병역 이행형태에 있어서는 직업군인(직업군인이었거나 직업군인 복무자), 군복무 면제자가 현역(의무병으로 복무하였거나 복무중인자), 방위병 복무자, 대체복무자에 비해서 병역정책신뢰도가 높게 나타나고 있다. 둘째, 개인심리적 요인 즉, 타인신뢰, 상대적 박탈감, 국가관과 병역정책신뢰와의 관계는 단순 상관관계 분석결과 타인신뢰, 국가관은 병역정책신뢰와 상관관계가 있는 것으로 나타났고, 상대적 박탈감의 경우는 부(-)의 관계로 나타났으며, 이는 회귀분석결과 통계적으로 유의성 있는 것으로 나타났다. 셋째, 정책내용 요인 즉. 병역의무의 형평성, 병역의무의 공정성과 병역정책신뢰와의 관계는 단순 상관관계 분석결과 매우 높게 나타났고 회귀분석 결과 병역정책신뢰에 미치는 영향력이 큰 것으로 나타났으며 통계적으로 유의성이 있다. 이는 병역정책 수립에 있어서 중요한 정책적 함의를 가지고 있다. 또한 공직자 요인 즉, 공무원의 부패, 공무원의 능력, 공복의식과 병역정책신뢰와의 관계는 단순 상관관계 분석결과 비교적 높은 상관관계를 보이고 있으나 회귀분석결과 병역정책신뢰에 미치는 영향력이 큰 것으로 나타났으며, 통계적으로 유의성이 있다. 정책홍보 요인 즉, 언론보도의 공정성, 언론보도의 적시성의 경우 병역정책신뢰와의 관계는 단순 상관관계분석에서 비교적 높은 상관관계를 보이고 있고 회귀분석 결과도 병역정책신뢰에 영향을 미치는 것으로 나타나고 있다. 넷째, 정보화 수준요인 즉, 행정정보화 수준, 개인정보화 수준과 병역정책신뢰와의 관계는 단순상관관계 분석결과 행정정보화 수준은 낮은 상관관계를, 개인정보화 수준은 부(-)의 상관관계로 나타났으며 회귀분석결과에서도 행정정보화 수준요인은 병역정책신뢰도에 정(+)의 영향을 미치는 것으로 나타나고 있으나 개인정보화 수준요인의 경우는 부(-)의 관계를 나타나고 있다. 다섯째, 본 경험적 연구에서 독립변수로 설정된 개인심리적 요인, 정책체계 요인, 정보화 수준요인이 병역정책신뢰도에 미치는 영향력의 정도는 회귀분석 결과 개별모형에 의한 영향력은 개인심리적 요인은 13.97%, 정책체계 요인은 39.99%, 정보화 수준요인은 14.09%의 영향력을 미치는 것으로 나타났으며, 이러한 결과는 전체모형의 회귀분석 결과에서도 입증되고 있다. 이러한 경험적 연구결과와 병역정책변수의 제한을 토대로 한 병역정책 신뢰성제고 방향을 요약하면 다음과 같다. 첫째, 병역의무의 공정성 확보를 위한 실질적인 병역면제 2심제도 운영을 위해 중앙신체검사소 조직을 병무청 본청에 두어야 한다. 둘째, 병역의무의 형평성제고와 병역자원 수급을 고려 대체복무제도는 축소 또는 폐지되어야 한다. 셋째, Internet을 통한 행정정보 공개제도와 대민서비스가 확대 시행되어야 한다.The contemporary administration is being closely tied to peoples' daily life by the expansion in function, enhancement of quality and consolidation of power in an executive government. The increasing importance in the administration, trust in the administration is directly related with the quality of life. However, the government of Korea, which is characterized by an insufficient trust in the administration, faces a crisis of trust in all areas including politics, society, economy and culture etc. This phenomena result in various types of conflicts in the interest group, social differentiation, region and labor affair etc. No government or policy has ever been received an indefinite trust by the people, however, the trust is a key factor for the government itself and a successful execution of the policy. Peoples' dissatisfaction or mistrust in a degree plays a positive role as a catalytic of the innovation in the administrative systems, however, it is impossible to achieve the object or effective execution of the policy without the peoples' trusts in policy of the government. Furthermore, the separation of the people from the administration obstructs cooperative relations, which might result in the negation of the governments' authority or the loss of the national identity. Reflecting on the importance of the trust of the government or its policy of people in the sense of regulation and practice, the empirical research has been conducted on the trust in the government and policy. In case of the United States, the Vietnamese War and the Watergate in 70s invoked a serious discussion on the trust in the government and policy; researchers paid attention to the trust in the government and administrative policy, because the variety of the administrative actions, whose operating area is being extended, cannot be successfully achieved without supports of the people with trust in the government and policy. In case of Korea, the mistrust of the people on the government and policy characterizes contemporary politics and administration via the tragic political history: the Japanese colony period and unorthodox administrations with military regime. Even though the mistrust in the government and policy has been well-known problem and the corresponding troubles have been experienced in the administrative execution, the problem of the trust in policy was recognized after 80s in Korea. While the main concerns of the research treated problems on the trust in the government (Lee, J.-H 1982, Yoon, S.-C 1985, Lee, S.-W 1993), few of them treated problems on the trust in policy (Moon T-H, 1987, Shim, J.-B 1990). Afterwards, the study on the trust in policy has been carried out in a practical application, however, most of them are focused on the application to the general policies, i.e., agriculture and residency etc. Application of the trust to a special policy, for example, national security or military manpower administration has not yet been sufficiently explored without investigations on the determinant factors of the trust in the policy. The application of the trust in policy to the military manpower administration is a timely and important research, because the military manpower administration suffers most aggressive innovation after the inauguration of President Kim, Dae-Jung. Especially, following two political issues enforced a renovation in the military manpower administration: one was the history of military service obligation of the presidential candidate and his family in 1997 presidential campaign in Korea, and the other was a military manpower administration scandal by WO. Won in May 1998. Considering the innovations of the military manpower administration with the inauguration of President Kim, Dae-Jung, it is necessary to measure the level of the trust in the policy. Furthermore, a methodology to enhance the trust in the policy, especially on the military manpower administration, will be discussed in this thesis. Therefore, following problems will be carefully treated and discussed in this thesis. ⅰ) Identification of the determinant factors on the military manpower administration policy ⅱ) Evaluation of the coherent relations among the factors on the trust in the military manpower administration policy ⅲ) Methodology to enhance the trust in the military manpower administration policy II. Theoretical Aspects of the Trust in Policy In the United States, the trust in policy has been regarded as an equivalency to the trust in politics. Scholars and researchers in politics agree that the trust in policy is a type of the political attitude defined by a positive or negative attitude against the policy if it meets the expectation of the people from the draft to the execution (Lee, H.-S, 1999). The political attitude is composed of cognitive, affective and behavioral factors. Therefore, also the attitude can be defined as follows: 'Attitude is a metal representation of a variety of social or physical objects, and it is acquired by experience thereafter affects on a behavioral patterns.'　Consequently, the political attitude has been regarded as a part of a political culture. Especially, the political culture is identified as a psychological orientation with regard to a political object by Almond, Massialas, Eaton. Moreover, the political attitude can be categorized by political trust, political efficacy and political participation. Among the rest, the political trust has been studied in a negative aspect such as political distrust or political cynicism rather than a positive one. Miller insists that the political trust is mainly comprised by a cognitive evaluation of the political systems product. In summary, the trust in policy can be defined by a kind of peoples' political attitude on the policy. More specifically, the trust in policy is a positive attitude on the policy if the policy satisfies the general criterion or expectation of the people in draft and execution. In addition, based on the concept of the trust by Meyer, which is widely accepted for the definition of the trust, the trust in policy can be defined by; a trust in policy is a psychological attitude so that the people can willingly accept it even with a corresponding risk independent of the capability of monitoring or regulating the policy　. In the study of the trust in the military manpower administration policy, it is important to define the military manpower administration policy as a type of the trust object. Definition of the policy varies depending on individual scholars, however, the policy can be defined as an activity or business provided by a government, in general. A policy will be continuously assessed from draft to closure, therefore, the assessment of the trust in policy are being utilized as a type of the preliminary study in administration. Therefore, the trust in the military manpower administration is postulated as a psychological attitude to the policy of the military manpower administration; the attitude is a comparative system which is composed by emotional and evaluative reactions. In this thesis, the factors of the attitude are categorized by cognitive, emotional and evaluative factors. Then the positive (or negative) evaluation of the fairness in the military manpower administration is to be conceptualized by the trust (or distrust) of the military manpower administration with emphasis on the emotional and evaluative factors. The cognitive factor is to be regarded as a prior factor in the evaluation of confirmation and decision. Consequently, the following definition of the trust in the military manpower administration is to be used in this thesis. 'Peoples' emotional and evaluative inclination on the military manpower administration is to determine whether military manpower administration satisfies peoples' ethnic standard and functional performance expectation.' III. Factors of the Trust in Military Manpower Policy In this thesis, based on the previous study the population, socio-economics and individual psychology factors are chosen for analysis. In addition, the factor of the accessibility to the information has been added considering the features of administrative information system in the military manpower administration and government of Korea. Those factors are summarized in terms of variables and measurement indices in Table 1. The factor of the accessibility to the information has been added, because the online web services provided by the government are being settled down as a primary tool to deliver information and service to the public. The distribution and expansion of the public information via web contributes the enhancement of the trust in the administration. ◁표 삽입▷(원문을 참조하세요) Numerous survey results in the United States show that the realization of the e-government (electronic service by government) enhances the trust in government of the people. It is a noticeable fact that the satisfaction or trust in the e-government is proportional to the accessibility or experience to the information: 35% of the electronic commerce system users show the trust in the government while 25% of the non-electronic commerce systems show the trust in the government. Recently the realization of the electronic government is becoming a key factor of the enhancement of the trust in the administration. (Kim, B. U. 2000). With a policy and increased budget of administrative information system, the performance and its assessment of the information systems are being focused. In the United States the performance of the website provided by the governments are assessed by various types of factors such as accuracy of contents, accessibility & simplicity of the information. Likewise, in Korea, the assessment and evaluation of the information systems of the government are started in 1997 and the Ministry of Information and Communication published 'Information System Assessment Manual' to provide a standard in the assessment. In the 'Information System Assessment Manual'　by the Ministry of Information and Communication, the assessment is mainly composed by the assessment of the efficiency and the assessment of the execution. The assessment of the efficiency is evaluated in terms of following factors: simplicity in usage, enhancement of service, satisfaction & application by user, efficiency in internal operation, renovation in system and efficiency in information system. The assessment of the execution is composed of business and system aspects where business plan, business process, business management and budget management are to be considered as the factors for the evaluation. The accessibility to the information has not yet been counted as a variable in the study of trust in policy, however, it is directly related to the trust in policy due to the contemporary trends of the administration which is characterized by participation of the people in the administration and transparency of the administration via the information system. Therefore, the accessibility to the information is assumed to be related with the trust in military manpower administration and it is assigned as a variable in this thesis. Reflecting on the recommendation in the 'Information System Assessment Manual'　by the Ministry of Information and Communication, the accessibility to the information and personal experience to the information are assigned as variables. Detailed descriptions of variables and measure indices are provided in Table 1. ◁표 삽입▷(원문을 참조하세요) In this thesis, the main objective is to determine the correlation between the trust in policy and factors by measuring the level of the trust in military manpower administration policy and identifying the factors that affect the trust in military manpower administration policy. Furthermore, the contributions of the individual factors are to be identified in a quantitative way so that a methodology to enhance the trust in the military manpower administration. A schematic diagram is provided in following figure for a description of the system model in terms of determinant factors described above. IV. Conclusion In this thesis, theoretical background, concept of the military manpower administration and the state of the art are carefully treated, which are used to establish a cause and effect system model in terms of the coherent factors on the trust in the military manpower administration policy. The objective of this thesis is to provide a methodology for the enhancement of the trust in the military manpower administration based on the empirical analysis. Based on the general theory, the investigation of preceding research and the state of the art, the relevant factors for the trust in military manpower administration policy has been identified. With the system modeling of the factors with the corresponding assumptions, the empirical analysis has been achieved. The result can be summarized as follows: 1. There is no significant difference on the trust in the military manpower administration in terms of gender, which is a subclass member of factor of population, in 1% significance level while a small difference in female with higher trust level than male for the military manpower administration in 5% significance level. In terms of age, there exists a significant difference between under age 30 and over age 40, specifically the trust level in the military manpower administration is high over age 40. Concerning on the socio-economic factor, there is no significant difference in personal income on the trust in the military manpower administration policy. However, the educational background influences on the trust in the military manpower administration policy so that the lower level educational (below with high school diploma) background group with higher level of trust in the military manpower administration policy in comparison with the higher level of the educational background (over college degree). In terms of occupation, housewife, farmer, small business groups show higher trust level in the trust in the military manpower administration policy than student, laborer, engineer, salary man and white color groups. 2. The relation between the trust in the military manpower administration policy and the personal psychological factors are almost negligible; based on the analysis of correlation with respect to the factors of mutual trust, relative deprivation and patriotism. 3. The contents of the policy factor is closely related with the trust in the military manpower administration policy. Therefore, the contents of the policy factor holds significant implication in the determination of the policy with trust. In addition, the factor of administrative public officers in terms of corruption, capability and spirit of service are closely related with the trust in the military manpower administration based on the simple correlation analysis. It is also shown to be effective by the regressive analysis within the statistical alert. The publicity of policy factor in terms of fairness and timing shows comparatively strong correlation with the trust in policy in the simple correlation analysis and the regressive analysis. 4. The accessibility to the information shows low correlation to the trust in the policy of the military manpower administration. In the simple correlation analysis of the factors to the trust in policy of the military manpower administration, the information system in the administration shows low correlation and the personal accessibility to the information shows negative correlation. In the regressive analysis of the factors to the trust in policy of the military manpower administration, the administrative information system shows positive correlation while the personal accessibility to the information shows negative correlation. 5. Based on the empirical study in this thesis by the regressive analysis, the contribution of the independent variable factors to the system model of the trust in the military manpower administration are evaluated as follows: 13.97% of the psychological factor, 39.99% of the policy system factor and 14.09% of the accessibility to the information factor, respectively. Based on the empirical study and the result of the analysis, following steps are need to be taken for the enhancement of the trust in the military manpower administration policy. 1. CPDC (Central Physical Draft Committee) is to be founded for the review of the exemption of the military service, which guarantees fairness and transparency in the physical draft. 2. Alternative military service obligation or reserve conscription must be reduced or abolished depending on supply and demand in military manpower to provide fairness and equality in the military service obligation. 3. The public release and service of the military manpower administration information is to be expanded via the Internet systems.

documents.title: 디자인씽킹을 적용한 IC-PBL 수업 역량 분석-디자인대학 수업 사례 중심으로-
documents.abstract: 본 연구는 4차 산업혁명에 따른 교육 혁신 과정에서 제기되고 있는 대안적 교수법인 자기주도 문제해결학습 PBL을 산업현장과 연계하여 실제적인 문제를 해결하는 IC-PBL(Industry-Coupled Problem-Based Learning)을 디자인대학에 적용하여 디자인교육 역량 향상을 검증하는 것에 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 구체적으로 디자인교육의 핵심인 창의적 문제해결능력과 최근 산업 전반에서 성공적 프로세스로 제기되는 디자인씽킹(Design Thinking)을 방법론으로 적용하였다. 디자인씽킹 기반 수업이 디자인 교육의 핵심역량 향상에 미치는 영향을 실증적으로 검증하기위해 경기도 소재 H대학 디자인대학 커뮤니케이션디자인학과 재학생 90명을 대상으로 디자인씽킹 기반 수업을 적용시킨 실험집단대상과 전통적인 강의식 수업방식을 적용시킨 통제집단으로 나누어 디자인교육 핵심역량을 하위 요소 8가지를 측정하여 비교분석 하였다. 연구결과 디자인씽킹 적용된 수업방식에서는 모든 역량의 영역에서 통계적으로 긍정에 유의미한 향상을 보인 반면, 강의식 기반 수업에서는 비교적 유의미한 향상이 나타나지 않은 결과를 보였다. 이와같은 역량 향상 결과는 디자인씽킹 기반 디자인수업이 보다 효과적인 교수학습방법의 전략이 될 수 있으며, 앞으로 4차산업혁명 시대에 미래지향적인 디자인교육 개선방안 위한 의미있는 기초자료가 될 수 있음을 시사한다.

documents.title: 從屬的 需要와 資材所要計劃(MRP)에 관한 硏究
documents.abstract: A Study of the Dependent Inventory and the Material Requirements Planning System with Emphasis on Production Planning, Lot-Sizing, and Multiplant CHAPTER 1. Introduction 1-1. Issue 1-2. Scope And Study Method CHAPTER 2. Dependent Inventory 2-1. Inventory System 2-2. Independent Inventory 2-3. Dependent Inventory CHAPTER 3. Material Requirement Planning 3-1. Dependent Inventory And Safety Stock 3-2. Material Requirement Planning System CHAPTER 4. Production Planning By M.R.P. 4-1. Level Decision Of Company 4-2. Level Decision Of Shop 4-3. Scheduling By M.R.P. CHAPTER 5. Production Lot Size Decision 5-1. Decision Mode By Production Lot Size 5-2. Requirement For Production Lot Size 5-3. M.R.P. System And Lot Size CHAPTER 6. M.R.P. In Multi-Plant 6-1. Decision Element 6-2. Planning 6-3. Common Part And Unification CHAPTER 7. Conclusion - References - CHAPTER 1. Introduction 1-1 Issue Successful production control depends on efficiency of production planning and scheduling. Production planning is completed based on capacity planning of component parts and finished products. Efficient production management comes from mutual corporation of capacity planning and production scheduling. After completion of Master Production Schedule, Bill of Material (BOM) is prepared for raw material and component part manufacturing. BOM is designed with the support of Production Engineering and Process Control. Material Requirement Planning (MRP) is to control raw material and components inventory for improving productivity and preventing any leakage in production system. In right time,place without any extra money. This is MRP system. We can say there is independent demand such as final product and dependent demand just like a lumpy demand of raw material. MRP is a kind of Production Control System which controls each work-in-process, finished goods and warehouse area. The key of success of MRP system is the completion of lot production in each specific process. Generally MRP system applies planning horizon as a weekly base. However, Current MRP system is not well connected to production planning. It goes separately planning and implementation. MRP is a good system for a shop; however, not for multi shops. If it is applied to multi-shop, it's out of control of dependent inventory and we can see bottle neck of too much or too small inventory. So, enhancement of MRP system for multi-shop is needed. 1-2. Scope of Study 1) Decision mode of lot-size in MRP system 2) Development of production planning method. 3) MRP application in multi-shop. CHAPTER 2. Dependent Inventory 2-1 Definition Of Inventory A. Inventory management - Most important element in production control - Inventory management is to maintain economic and optimum inventory level B. Inventory Contents - Finished goods - Work-in-process - Raw material - Goods to be arrived C. Character of inventory ◁표 삽입▷(원문을 참조하세요) D. Function of inventory - Adjust to production quantity and sales demands - Level of inventory High; occur to change-lost cost increase maintenance cost Shortage; Decrease machine and man-hour efficiency E. Kinds of inventory - Safety stock; Uncertain sales forecast Production and material lead time. - Lot-size stock; Remained stock of lot purchasing and manufacturing. F. Target of inventory - Fit to changing demands - Keep the economic inventory level 2.2 Independent Inventory Management A. Discrete model B. Order (Demand) is delivered directly C. Balance-on-hand always positive condition D. According to B&C total cost is consist of inventory maintenance cost (carring cost) and ordering cost. E. Each item has separate order. F. Certain demand & supply and lead time exist C = Annual total cost Q = Order q'ty or lot size D = Annual demands C₁ = Carrying cost per unit C₃ = Ordering cost per unit Q* = E.O.Q. (Economic order q'ty) C = Q/2 C₁ + D/Q C₃ Q*(EOQ) = √(2DC₃/C₁) CHAPTER 3. Material Requirement / Resource Planning Material requirement planning set up by required quantity. Required time of raw material, parts, WIP and assembly based on final product quantity and schedule. Material resource planning is to decide the parts quanity, production time and supplier of raw material. MRP system controls the followings. a. Order time & q'ty b. Production going status c. Lead & lag d. Plans changing by situation e. Priority f. Facility capability data g. Customer serviceability h. Facility and man-power operation. MRP merit is to decide the possibility of plan implementation under the given circumstances such as model, master production schedule, time bucket, change range, etc. Part order method for safety stock - Fixed order q'ty - Period order q'ty - under uncertainity Normally lot for lot order has been used in MRP. As a better method, node algorithm is introduced. CHAPTER 4. Production Planning By MRP 4-1 Top Manager's Decision Making for Production. Top management needs much data for decision making, because the company has many factories, various changing environments such as changing demands. Factory production schedule is subject to factory conditions and structure such as layout, facility, warehouse and man-power. Production schedule must include these information. 4-2 Decision Making for Factory Production After Master Production Schedule(MPS) & Target is decided, each factory plans factory production schedule. MPS relates to detail production schedule and material planning. Detail production schedule must be planed for efficient production and purchasing. These cover assembly, parts, material, module, etc. After decision of detail production schedule, manager must control personnel, parts, supplier, delivery, etc. 4-3 MRP & Detail Production Schedule Main purpose of MRP is to find material requirement by production schedule and bill of material. MRP system calculates required parts and delivery by detail production schedule. MRP system provides material requirement to the lowest level CHAPTER 5. Decision Of Lot Size 5-1 Lot size by L.P. (Linear Programming) Generally, L.P. is used for the decision of lot size. Followings are main factors for Production Schedule. I_(t) = Inventory W_(t) = Workers MR_(t) = Required time for production MO_(t) = Required over time for production ...... WG_(t) = Labour cost 5-2 Lot Size Qt(i) = K t Q(i) Lot size is decided when inventory cost and production cost in minimized. Lot size of multi-prod system is decided by integer programming method. It's called NODE algorithm same as decision tree. NODE Algorithm ◁표 삽입▷(원문을 참조하세요) CHAPTER 6. MRP In Multi-Shop Generally manufacturing industry has multi-placed factory with his supplier. In this kind of business, transportation cost is too important as well as in-transit time. MRP is very convenient in single shop, but most company which is consist of multi-shop located is trying to apply MRP in these days. So, assembly shop and other shop in multi-plant are having too much inventory and require long lead time N BOH = BOH + IT - SS MRP characteristics in multi-shop. 1) MRP system in multi-shop is very flexible to meet each shop operation. 2) Balance on hand calculation. 3) Transportation mode is for saving of in-transit cost, handling and reducing lead time. 4) MRP system in single shop require the accuracy of quantity in complete product, WIP and BOM. CHAPTER 7. CONCLUSION Independent demand product must maintain adequate safety stock to meet customer requirement. But dependent demand product is vise-versa. MRP definition is, It is a management tool that supports manufacturing production schedules. What MRP does is to systematically & in an orderly manner find what items are required to be made or purchased within a sufficient lead time to enable the items to be available when required for production. Therefore MRP merit is to 1) Set up suitable plan against situation change. 2) Expedite production time and control delivery. 3) Coordinate production and inventory. Under the next condition, to have high performance in inventory 1) When manufacturing process is too complex 2) When product price is expensive. 3) When long lead item is needed 4) When complete assembling process is too long 5) When E.O.Q. decides in various product.

documents.title: QFD 기반의 SI업체 품질경영 평가모형
documents.abstract: In recent years, forces from factors such as globalization of market, continuous change in IT environments, rapid technological improvement, and shortening product life-cycle require the structural change of management strategies in almost every business sector. Though main stream of activities for quality management has been applied to the areas of product or service oriented business, the enhancement of TQM capability is also very important to gain the competitive advantage of SI company globally. This paper suggests an assessment model for TQM of SI company and proposes a template for improvement guidelines based on the evaluation of company's capability for TQM. For that purpose, firstly, new evaluation factors for capability of quality management were developed; secondly, the different evaluation framework from that of product-oriented company, which was based on the characteristics of software and SI company, were derived; thirdly, the derived guidelines were integrated with factors from SPICE/CMM; and lastly a new assessment model was developed based on QFD.  With this model, we expect more objective weights can be derived and used for assessment of TQM capability. And also the more systematic and implemental guidelines for improvements can be derived from model's critical success factors.

documents.title: In this issue
documents.abstract:
Abstract

Wolf in sheep's clothing or sheep in wolf's clothing

pp. 580-590

Proteomic studies had shown that breast cancer cells express much higher levels of TrkA (tyrosine kinase receptor, a neurotrophin) than did normal tissue. Furthermore, the in vitro invasiveness and in vivo metastatic capability of breast tumor cells were enhanced. To find out which proteins were involved in the enhancement, Lagadec et al. applied classic proteome techniques: 2‐DE, MALDI‐TOF and LC‐MS/MS. Of the ∼1500 spots resolved, more than 20 were up‐ or down‐regulated. In TrkA overexpressing cells, protein Ku86 was also found at increased levels, Western blots validating 2‐DE and MS findings. Ku86 mRNA levels remained unchanged however. Ku proteins seem to be of the mobile sort ‐ involved in cell migration, proliferation and invasion. Ku70 has been reported to stimulate cancer cell survival in the face of apoptosis. Thus, both Ku86 and Ku70 can help normal or cancer cells survive and grow. magnified image

Antibody microarray proteomes segregate glioblastoma multiforme types

pp. 591-602

Glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), the most frequent and aggressive brain tumor type, does not appear to be a single disease on close examination. It shows a great deal of molecular heterogeneity and a “stealth” mechanism of infection that causes difficulty in selecting an appropriate therapy. Most therapies do not do much more than add a few days of survival except for some autoimmune therapies, which may give a 60% extension of survival. Getting such extensions is highly variable. Carlsson et al. took it as a challenge to adapt their earlier microarray technology for the analysis of GBM. Working with 18 GBMpatients and 17 controls, they prepared biotin‐labelled serum samples and Alexa‐647‐labelled streptavidin detection reagents. The detection array comprised 138 human scFv antibodies against 60 different antibodies. After statistical analysis, it was clear that the binding information was sufficient to distinguish the patients that would benefit from immunotherapy. magnified image

Looking for the end of the rainbow

pp. 654-673

About 30% of the time after a heart attack (MI), the heart attempts to reconstruct damaged areas, such as left ventricular remodeling (LVR) after damage to an anterior wall, but the result is usually ischemic heart failure. Fertin et al. used combinatorial peptide ligand library (CPLL) and SELDITOF‐MS technology to minimize abundance disparity problems ‐ too much albumin, too little of low abundance factors. Analyzing CPLL profiles from samples taken 4 times in the course of a year (at 0, 1, 3, and 12 months), 73 peaks exhibited modulation that correlated with the degree of remodeling. Interestingly, serum and plasma from the same patient did not correlate except in two cases. Most of the peaks could only be identified when treated by CPLL before SELDI‐TOF‐MS. magnified image

documents.title: 공감능력 척도 및 프로그램 개발
documents.abstract: 이 연구의 목적은 상담자의 공감능력을 측정할 수 있는 공감능력 척도를 개발하고 공감능력을 제고하기 위하여 공감능력향상프로그램을 개발하여 그 효과를 살펴보는 것이다. 이러한 연구의 목적을 달성하기 위하여, 선행연구들을 고찰하여 공감과 공감능력의 개념을 새롭게 정립하였고, 공감능력을 측정할 수 있는 다차원 공감능력척도를 개발하고 일반화가능성을 높이기 위한 타당화 연구를 수행하였으며, 공감능력의 효과 검증에 대한 연구와 더불어 공감능력을 향상시킬 수 있는 집단상담 프로그램을 개발하고 그 효과를 검증하는 연구를 진행하였다.&#xD; 공감능력 척도 개발 연구는 10대에서 50대까지 남자 231명과 여자 242명을 포함하여 전체 473명의 자료를 수집하였다. 수집된 자료를 SAS9.2와 SPSS21을 이용하여 자료를 분석하였다. 사용된 척도의 신뢰도 검증은 상관분석을 사용하였는데, 척도의 내적일관성을 알아보는 Cronbach의 알파계수를 검토하였다. 척도의 타당도 검증은 요인분석을 사용하였는데, 요인분석을 할 때 기준 값은 다중상관계수를 적용하고 분석방법은 주축분해법을 사용하고, 회전방법은 배리맥스 방식을 적용하여 분석하였다. 최종 요인에 포함된 항목들은 요인부하량이 .40 이상인 것으로 각각 6개씩 구성하였다. 최종 요인구조는 인지적 공감과 정서적 공감 및 행동적 공감 모두 각각 2개씩 6개 요인이 추출되었는데, 인지적 공감은 관점수용요인과 사고조절요인, 정서적 공감은 감정표현요인과 감정몰입요인, 행동적 공감은 의사소통요인과 관계형성요인으로 명명하였다. &#xD; 공감능력 척도 타당화 연구에서는 남자 300명과 여자 290명을 포함하여 전체 590명이 연구에 참여하였다. 수집된 자료는 SPSS21과 AMOS를 사용하여 분석하였는데, 척도개발 연구에서 추출된 요인들에 대한 확인적 요인분석으로 공분산구조모형을 검토하여 개발된 척도의 구성타당도를 재확인하는 타당화 작업을 진행하였다. 연구결과, 이론모형과 측정모형의 구조모형의 적합도가 우수한 것으로 확인되었고, 구성된 척도의 변별타당도로 높은 것으로 확인되었다. 성별에 따른 공감능력의 차이에서는 관점수용능력에서는 남자가 사고조절능력과 감정몰입능력, 의사소통능력에서는 여자가 높은 것으로 공감능력의 성차를 확인하였다. 연령대에 따른 공감능력의 차이에서는 20대가 50대보다 공감능력이 높은 것으로 나타나 나이가 많을수록 공감능력이 떨어짐을 확인할 수 있었다.&#xD; 긍정심리학적 관점을 취하면서 공감능력의 효과검증을 알아본 연구에서는 공감능력의 차이에 따라서 긍정심리자본과 행복에서 차이가 나타남을 확인하였다. 공감능력이 높은 사람들이 공감능력이 낮은 사람들보다 긍정심리자본이 더 높고, 더 행복한 것으로 나타났다. 또한 긍정심리자본과 행복간의 관계에서 공감이 매개효과를 갖는지 조절효과를 갖는지를 알아보았는데, 공감능력의 부분 매개 효과를 확인하였다.&#xD; 공감능력향상 프로그램 개발 연구는 ADDIE 모델의 개발절차에 따라 인지적, 정서적, 행동적 공감능력을 포함한 다차원적 공감능력향상 집단상담 프로그램을 개발하였다. 집단상담 프로그램은 공감능력 개념에 부합하게 6개의 핵심 회기를 구성하였는데, 각 회기는 80분씩 진행되었고 각 회기의 주제는 관점수용하기, 부정적 사고 알아채기, 정서 알아차리기, 타인의 감정 알아차리기, 언어적-비언어적 소통, 관계형성을 위한 피드백에 관한 것이다. &#xD; 새롭게 개발된 공감능력향상 집단상담 프로그램의 효과를 알아보기 위하여 인지적 공감과 정서적 공감에 주안점을 둔 단기프로그램으로 예비연구를 실시한 다음에, 인지적 공감과 정서적 공감뿐만 아니라 행동적 공감을 모두 포함한 8회기의 최종 집단상담 프로그램을 실시한 실험집단과 그렇지 않은 통제집단으로 구분하여 공감능력, 긍정심리자본, 및 행복뿐만 아니라 직무소진, 불안, 및 우울의 변화를 살펴보면서 집단상담 치료효과를 알아보았다. 연구결과에 의하면, 집단상담 프로그램에 참여하기 전보다 참여한 후에 공감능력, 긍정심리자본 및 행복수준 그리고 집단상담 치료효과는 더 높아지는 반면에, 직무소진, 우울 및 불안이 더 낮아지는 경향성을 보였다. 구체적으로 살펴보면, 첫째, 사전검사에서 나오지 않았던 통제집단과 실험집단 간의 공감능력의 차이가 공감능력향상 프로그램에 참여하고 난 다음에 나타났다. 특히, 관점수용능력과 의사소통능력에서 많은 향상을 확인하였다. 둘째, 긍정심리자본의 하위요인들 중 낙관주의 요인에서 많은 향상을 보였다. 셋째, 개인행복지수와 하위요인 중 성공 요인에서 향상이 나타났다. 끝으로, 공감능력향상 집단상담 프로그램에 참여한 후에 집단상담 치료효과가 직면을 제외하고 모든 하위요인에서 향상이 나타났다. 이런 연구결과는 새롭게 개발된 공감능력향상 집단상담 프로그램이 상담효과를 높이는데 구체적인 기여를 할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 상담 장면에 널리 활용될 수 있음을 보여주는 것이다. &#xD;

documents.title: 경기도 공동체 에너지 잠재량 분석 및 정책적 시사점
documents.abstract: 본 연구의 목적은 경기도 공동체 에너지의 잠재량을 분석하고 정책적 시사점을 도출하는데 있다. 분석을 위해 공동체에너지로 활용 가능한 건축물 유형을 분류한 후 옥상면적을 산출하고 건축연한과 건축물 유형별 설치계수를 반영하여태양광 잠재량을 도출하였으며, 베란다 미니태양광 잠재량을 별도로 산정하여 포함하였다. 분석결과 공동체 에너지 건축물 태양광 잠재량은 2.36GW로 경기도 에너지비전 목표 달성을 위한 잠재력이 매우 큰 것으로 나타났으며, 공동주택, 단독주택, 학교 순으로 잠재량이 높았다. 하지만 공동체 에너지 건축물 잠재량의 약 6.4%만 활용되어 생산량이 미미한수준이며, 주민, 시민단체 등 공동체 역량과 기초지자체의 정책 인프라도 취약한 실정이다. 에너지전환을 위한 전략으로서 공동체 에너지의 잠재력 실현을 위해서는 첫째, 공동체의 역량 배양과 파트너십을 지원하고 중간지원조직 육성 및 지원, 멘토링 및 컨설팅 서비스 제공 등 공동체 에너지 확산에 필요한 사회적 인프라와 생태계를 조성할 필요가 있다. 둘째, 공동체 에너지로서 접근성과 잠재력이 높은 곳을 우선적으로 선정하여 공간별 특성에 따른 실행전략을 마련한다. 구도심 단독주택, 아파트 단지, 발전소 및 송변전소 주변지역, 농촌 등 유형별로 다양한 에너지자립마을 모델을 만드는 것이바람직하다. 셋째, 공동체 에너지를 지속적이고 체계적으로 추진할 수 있는 거버넌스를 구축하고 정책 지원을 강화한다.특히 에너지협동조합을 활성화하여 재생에너지 생산을 위한 주민참여 통로를 제공하고 에너지전환 거점으로 활용한다.

documents.title: Sensitivity factors based computationally efficient approach for evaluation and enhancement of available transfer capability
documents.abstract: Available transfer capability (ATC) is an indication of the capability of the transmission system to efficiently increase power transmission for further commercial trading between two areas or two points. ATC plays an important role in operating power systems economically, reliably, and securely. As the deregulation in the power system can cause overload in the transmission system, ATC evaluation and enhancement are required for secure and reliable operation. The advancements in power generation techniques and switching from centralized generation to distributed generation (DG) with more emphasis on renewable sources have resulted in various approaches to enhance ATC. In this work, a computationally efficient sensitivity-based methodology for evaluating and improving ATC with the presence of renewable generation is proposed. The developed approach is implemented on the IEEE 30 bus system and the outcome is compared with the existing methods in the literature.

documents.title: 포유동물 세포용 DMSO 비사용 무혈청 동결보존배지 개발 및 최적화 연구
documents.abstract: Preserving and maintaining the functional characteristics of cells when used in the production of biopharmaceuticals is crucial. Cells may experience functional losses over extended periods of cultivation, and to mitigate this, large-scale cultivation followed by cryopreservation is employed. Cryoprotective agents (CPAs) are used during cryopreservation to minimize damage to cells, with Dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) being the most commonly used. However, numerous studies have demonstrated the harmful effects of DMSO on cells, prompting active research into alternatives for cryopreservation. In a previous study, prototypes of DMSO-free cryopreservation media were developed for CHO cells and HEK293 cells, commonly used in the production of biotherapeutics. In this study, we aim to enhance these prototypes. The previously held Cell Freezing Media (CFM) consisted of two types, each tailored for CHO cells and HEK293 cells, utilizing the in-house cell cultivation media SJ- CDM 3.0 modified for cell cryopreservation as the basal medium. As an alternative to DMSO, the main CPA, along with polymers and antioxidants as auxiliary substances to compensate for deficient cryopreservation capabilities, was employed. In this current study, we enhanced the effectiveness of CPAs through concentration optimization, the addition of novel cryoprotective agents, and Full Factorial Design (FFD). We grouped the components of SJ-CFM and simplified the composition through group-specific concentration optimization to enhance cryopreservation capabilities. In conclusion, through this study, we developed two DMSO-free, serum-free, and chemically defined cryopreservation media with enhanced efficacy and simplified composition compared to existing cryopreservation media. These new formulations demonstrate effects equivalent to or surpassing DMSO, showcasing their potential for advanced cell preservation in the context of biopharmaceutical production. Keywords: Cryopreservation, DMSO, Cryoprotective agent (CPA), Optimization, Grouping, Fortification
documents.author: 김준호

documents.title: 중소기업에 대한 행정서비스품질 모형에 관한 탐색적 연구: 디자인역량강화사업을 중심으로
documents.abstract: This study on the Design Capability Enhancement Business(Project) examines the effects of administrative service quality on customer satisfaction and business performance of small and medium-sized firms. Five factors to measure administrative service quality are identified by factor analysis, namely service quality of a design firm, after-service and infrastructure quality, personnel quality for administrative support, prior quality at application stage, and appropriateness of time and budget; these factors have high explanatory capacity in gauging administrative service quality. Measuring performance is conducted in terms of technical aspects(design) and economic facets(revenue) based on KPIs which are identified through expert panel discussions. Based on the survey of 39 small and medium-sized firms, the results show that follow-up management and infra quality, which is one of the factors of administrative service quality for the Design Capability Enhancement Business(Project), is significant at p<0.1 but other service quality factors don’t significantly affect customer satisfaction. Furthermore, the technical and economic performance are both enhanced in terms of relationship between customer satisfaction and business performance with respect to comparing the pre- and post-Design Capability Enhancement Business(Project). In all, the effect of administrative service quality cannot be easily concluded but we can argue that customer satisfaction affects business performance in terms of supporting business(project) for small and medium-sized firms.

documents.title: 역량접근의 관점에서 우간다 아동노동 해결을 위한 교육정책 연구: 탄자니아와 케냐의 사례를 중심으로
documents.abstract: Child labor is a significant obstacle to the realization of education for the large &#xD; majority of children in Uganda. This study proposes education as the suitable &#xD; remedy to child labor since children engage in child labor activities at school &#xD; going age. However, the foreign style of education must not be considered ideal &#xD; for the lives of child laborers because purpose and value of education change &#xD; from society to society. Therefore, this study investigates the link between child &#xD; labor, poverty and education and employs a capability-based perspective to &#xD; understand the relationship between child labor and schooling. The study then &#xD; discusses alternative strategies that might provide alternative solutions to the &#xD; problem of child labor. In this regard, meaningful educational chances or &#xD; opportunities must be realized (with freedom of choice) using the most efficient &#xD; and readily available ways of ensuring income stability, safety and well-being &#xD; of children based on capability approach.&#xD;

documents.title: Study on the Integration Factors of Human Resource Management Strategy and Corporate Strategy
documents.abstract: <jats:p>By analysing the integration factors of human resource management strategy and corporate strategy, this study discusses the factors affecting the integration, including three aspects: organisational culture, human resource management capability and external environment. Among them, in terms of organisational culture, organisational culture has an important impact on the integration of human resource management strategy and corporate strategy, organisational culture plays an important role in shaping employees' behaviour and motivation, and organisational culture has an important impact on the development and enhancement of human resource management capability. In terms of human resource management capability, human resource management capability plays an important role in the smooth implementation of the integration strategy, human resource management capability plays an important role in the shaping and transmission of culture within the organisation, and human resource management capability also plays an important role in promoting staff development and training within the organisation. As for the external environment, five aspects such as political, economic, technological, social and legal are analysed.</jats:p>

documents.title: BT-IT(BIT) 융합기술
documents.abstract: 본고에서는 최신 과학기술 분야의 화두가 되고 있는 생명공학(BT)과 정보통신(IT)의 융합기술에 대해서 소개한다. 대표적인 기술로 바이오인포매틱스, 바이오칩, 바이오센서, 그리고 이들의 총체적인 기술인 유비쿼터스 헬스케어 시스템에 대해서 알아본다. BT, IT 융합기술을 통해 과학기술 분야에 새로운 연구분야와 효율적인 분석 기술을 제공해줌으로써, 인류의 건강에 큰 도움을 줄 것으로 기대된다.

documents.title: 산업의 융합과 IT-BT-NT 융합기술
IT-BT-NT 기술 융합에 따른 산업육성전략
documents.abstract: 최근 IT, BT, NT 기술간 융합이 가속화되면서 새로운 형태의 기술과 서비스가 등장하고 있다. 미국, 일본, 유럽 등 선진국은 정부와 기업이 연대하여 기술간 융합을 고부가가치 창출에 필요한 첨단기술로 인식하고 융합기술 개발을 적극적으로 추진하고 있고, 우리 정부도 과학기술부, 산업자원부, 정보통신부를 중심으로 융합기술 발전계획을 수립하고 있다. 융합기술 개발을 통해 미래의 핵심기술을 확보하고, 컨버전스 시대의 조류에 대응하며, 새로운 성장동력을 창출하고, 건강하고 안전한 삶을 실현할 수 있다. 본고에서는 먼저 IT-BT-NT 융합기술의 분류, 특징 및 기대효과를 살펴보고, 산업육성전략 방안을 제시하고자 한다.

documents.title: IT 기술로 강화된 생체현미경기술 -IT와 BT 기술의 융합 예
documents.abstract: 최근의 생명공학기술(Biotechnology, BT)은 정보통신기술(Information Technology, IT)을 떼고 생각할 수 없을 정도로 IT는 BT에 있어서 매우 중요한 역할을 하고 있다. BT에서 가장 중요한 전통적 툴 중 하나인 현미경도 그 예외가 아니다. 기존의 샘플을 눈으로만 관찰하는 단순 현미경이 아니라, 여러 생명 현상들을 생체 내에서 추적하고 실시간 분석을 해주는 첨단 현미경기술에서의 IT는 그 역할을 점점 더 강화하고 있다. 이 글에서는 생체현미경기술(Intravital Microscopy)에서 문제점을 극복하는 데 IT 기술이 어떻게 사용되고 있는지 살펴보기로 한다.
